scenario.objective: Show a guild member's current voice channel in the Flutter members panel and use a screen icon while that member is sharing their screen.
scenario.expected: Fresh, unambiguous voice roster data shows the channel caption and voice icon; screen_sharing switches the icon and accessible description. Stale, unavailable, empty, or ambiguous data shows no voice status.
scenario.existing_behavior_audit: Voice roster API/state and per-channel voice member stream icons were already present in Flutter. The guild-wide members panel did not consume roster or screen-sharing state. Only this missing panel behavior was added.
